div.div: Comparison between different Transformer blocks. (Left) The standard Pre-LN block. (Top Right) Our most simplified block. (Bottom Right) The parallel block (Zhao et al., 2019; Wang & Komatsuzaki, 2021). Like the parallel block, our block eschews the need for sequential sub-blocks, but we additionally remove all skip connections and normalisation layers, as well as value and projection parameters. Here, ⊗ denotes a matrix multiplication, and ⊕ denotes a (potentially weighted) sum.
